2607.13854.title: SPyCE: Skill-Policy Co-evolution for Multimodal Agents
2607.13854.paper_summary: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning trajectories should be distilled into reusable skills that co-evolve with the policy during training, rather than being consumed as rewards or retrieved from a static store. To this end, we propose SPyCE (Skill-Policy Co-evolution), a framework that distills trajectories into a hierarchical skill library and updates it throughout reinforcement learning. Execution skills capture local visual operations, while workflow skills encode high-level priors that orchestrate tool use. During training, the policy model conditions on retrieved skills to guide its rollouts, while the skill library evolves using valuable rollouts generated by the policy. This creates a closed loop in which improved policies yield better skills, and the evolving skill library, in turn, provides stronger priors for policy rollouts. Experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that SPyCE consistently outperforms both RL-based and memory-based baselines. Further analysis reveals that both the hierarchical skill design and the co-evolution mechanism are critical to our design. These results suggest joint skill-policy optimization as a promising paradigm for building capable multimodal agents.
2607.13854.paper_summary_zh: 多模態代理透過圖像進行思考，反覆操作視覺證據並在多個步驟中調用工具。現有的強化學習方法將軌跡簡化為標量獎勵，迫使策略在每個新任務中從頭開始發現可重用的工具使用模式；基於記憶的替代方案保留過去的經驗，但它們依賴於測試時的檢索，而不更新策略以吸收來自該經驗的可重用模式。我們的關鍵見解是，多模態推理軌跡應該被提煉成可重用的技能，這些技能在訓練過程中與策略共同演化，而不是作為獎勵被消耗或從靜態存儲中檢索。為此，我們提出了SPyCE（技能-政策共演化），這是一個將軌跡提煉為層次技能庫並在整個強化學習過程中進行更新的框架。執行技能捕捉局部視覺操作，而工作流程技能編碼高層次的先驗知識，以協調工具使用。在訓練期間，策略模型依賴檢索到的技能來指導其展開，而技能庫則利用策略生成的有價值的展開進行演化。這創造了一個閉環，其中改進的策略產生更好的技能，而不斷演化的技能庫又為策略展開提供更強的先驗知識。在八個基準測試中的實驗表明，SPyCE 始終優於基於強化學習和基於記憶的基準。進一步分析顯示，層次技能設計和共演化機制對我們的設計至關重要。這些結果表明，聯合技能-政策優化是一個建造能幹的多模態代理的有前景的範式。
